meta.title: Barnstormers
meta.notes: One paid generation, extended once. barnstormers-1-t1 (8 s, from ch-barnstormers-1) was continued by the provider with ch-barnstormers-2 (8 s), which returns the source clip and its new tail as one 16 s file, barnstormers-full-t1, byte-identical to review/clips/ch-barnstormers.mp4. Nothing was laid over it. Its first 192 frames match barnstormers-1-t1 and the barn doors burst open on frame 192 (8.0 s). The segments are the take's own shots, in step, cut where the picture cuts (frame/24). Nobody speaks: the sound is the take's own action-synth music, welding, hammering and the crash through the crates. The music is in the take's own sound, so it is a music item that labels it, from the first frame to the last.
